difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for composable morphisms f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z of FTS_S, the lemma asserts Rg_! o Rf_! = R(g o f)_! with the notation of Remark labelled remark-composition-lower-shriek (statement lines 8881-8920). By the discussion in Categories, Remark labelled categories-remark-pro-category-copresheaves it suffices to show that the two sides give the same answer on Hom into any L in D^b_Coh(O_Z), and the proof computes a six term chain: Hom_Z(Rg_!Rf_!K, L) = colim_n Hom_Z(Rg_!M_n, L) by the definition of the composite; = colim_n Hom_Y(M_n, g^!L) by Proposition labelled proposition-duality-compactly-supported for g; = Hom_Y(Rf_!K, g^!L) since Rf_!K is given by the system (M_n); = Hom_X(K, f^!g^!L) by the same proposition for f; = Hom_X(K, (g o f)^!L) by Lemma labelled lemma-upper-shriek-composition; and = Hom_Z(R(g o f)_!K, L) by the proposition for g o f (proof lines 8922-8947). Chaining the duality for compactly supported pushforward with the composition of the upper shriek functors is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
